design.site_summary: A partially shaded balcony microclimate designed for a curious dog named Barnaby, utilizing completely safe and verified non-toxic botanicals.
design.layout_strategy: Trailing plants on the railing at eye level, upright herbs and foliage at mid height against the wall, and a low ground layer along the balcony edge within reach of Barnaby.
design.combination_logic: The combination contrasts the fine, upright green foliage of Chinese Evergreen with the soft cascading growth habit of safe trailing elements, providing seasonal interest, varied textures, and vibrant green tones that thrive together under partial shade.

zones.placement: on the east-facing balcony edge floor, 3 h of morning sun, fully accessible to Barnaby the dog

plants.why: Provides lush green foliage at ground level that is safely positioned and attractive for the dog to interact with.
plants.role_in_combination: Acts as the primary ground-level textured green element, contrasting with vertical railing displays.

maintenance: Water thoroughly when top inch of soil is dry
Inspect leaves weekly for dust accumulation
Fertilize monthly during active growth season

zones.placement: on the east-facing railing, 4 h of morning sun, elevated safely above floor level

plants.why: Brings lush green color and height variation to the vertical hanging display.
plants.role_in_combination: Provides a contrasting upright green focal point within the cascading vertical layout.

maintenance: Check moisture levels twice weekly in summer
Prune dead or yellowing tips in spring
Repot every two years into fresh potting mix

care_instructions.task: Watering all containers thoroughly until drainage occurs
care_instructions.frequency: twice a week in summer, weekly in spring and autumn

care_instructions.task: Applying organic liquid fertilizer to sustain foliage growth
Checking for root congestion and repotting container plants

care_cautions: Overwatering the hanging baskets on the railing can lead to root rot if drainage holes are blocked.
The Balcony Edge Grazing Zone must be monitored to ensure Barnaby does not dig up the substrate from the containers.
design.pet_safety_note: This design strictly keeps Barnaby safe by featuring non-toxic verified plant species and placing accessible elements appropriately for interactive enrichment.
